:::{#exm-agreement-test-measures}
#### Test measures for the COVID-19 test

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
@def-agreement-test-measures gives:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
test_measures <- with(as.list(agree_covid), c(
  sensitivity = a / (a + c),
  specificity = d / (b + d),
  ppv = a / (a + b),
  npv = d / (c + d)
))
round(test_measures, 4)
```

These estimates match
the test's sensitivity (`r round(test_measures[["sensitivity"]], 2)`)
and specificity (`r round(test_measures[["specificity"]], 2)`),
its positive predictive value
(about `r round(test_measures[["ppv"]], 2)`, @exm-ppv),
and its negative predictive value
(about `r round(test_measures[["npv"]], 3)`, @exm-npv),
because the table's counts are the expected counts for those values.

:::
